product_brief: A ring-compatible Rust cryptographic library using AWS-LC for its cryptographic operations, with FIPS support via aws-lc-fips-sys.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-DSA (ML_DSA_44/65/87) signature APIs, now stable and available under the fips feature
pqc_capability_description: As of v1.18.0, ML-DSA signature APIs (PqdsaKeyPair, PqdsaPublicKey, PqdsaSigningAlgorithm, PqdsaVerificationAlgorithm; ML_DSA_44/65/87) are stable in aws_lc_rs::signature, no longer need the unstable feature, and are available under fips since the AWS-LC-FIPS 4.0 module provides ML-DSA.
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA (ML_DSA_44, ML_DSA_65, ML_DSA_87), RSA, ECDSA P-256, SHA-256, AES-256-GCM, AEAD
architecture_type: Software cryptographic library (Rust bindings over AWS-LC; FIPS builds via aws-lc-fips-sys)
fips_validated: Partial — AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x (shipped in aws-lc-rs v1.17.x) is FIPS 140-3 validated (Certificate #5314 static, Certificate #5298 dynamic); the 4.x module used from v1.18.0 has completed validation testing by an accredited lab and has been submitted to NIST for certification
primary_platforms: Rust; Linux targets use the static build of AWS-LC-FIPS; x86_64 and aarch64 on Linux, macOS, Windows mentioned in size-optimization tests; AWS Regions
regulatory_status: FIPS 140-3 validated for AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x (Certificates #5314 and #5298); AWS-LC-FIPS 4.x submitted to NIST for certification
signature_schemes: ML-DSA (ML_DSA_44, ML_DSA_65, ML_DSA_87), RSA, ECDSA P-256
implementation_attack_surface: KeyEncryptionKey zeroizes key material on drop; KeyEncryptionKey::unwrap no longer underflows on ciphertexts shorter than 8 bytes. Side-channel and fault injection risks are not discussed.
testing_&_validation_methods: Valgrind configuration and CI (including binary size tests and mdbook docs checks) are present in the repository; FIPS validation testing by an accredited lab for AWS-LC-FIPS.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Open source (Apache-2.0 or ISC) maintained by AWS; depends on the aws-lc-sys or aws-lc-fips-sys FFI crates and upstream AWS-LC (v5.5.0); pre-notification of releases available for packagers.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Existing unstable ML-DSA consumers keep compiling with deprecation warnings; builds with #![deny(warnings)] or glob-importing both signature::* and unstable::signature::* need source changes; PqdsaKeyPair::to_pkcs8 renamed to to_pkcs8v1; pin aws-lc-rs <1.18.0 to stay on FIPS 3.x; parsed_verify_digest_sig now always returns Unspecified.
organizational_readiness: Consult local FIPS compliance experts before upgrading to the FIPS 4.x module.

evidence.PQC Support: The ML-DSA signature APIs are now stable 🎉
evidence.PQC Capability Description: ML-DSA no longer requires the unstable feature, and is now available under fips -- the FIPS 4.0 module provides ML-DSA
evidence.FIPS Validated: The FIPS v3 module shipped in aws-lc-rs v1.17.x is FIPS 140-3 validated ( Certificate #5314 static, Certificate #5298 dynamic).
evidence.License: This library is licensed under the Apache-2.0 or the ISC License.
evidence.Crypto Primitives: a small binary exercising SHA-256, AES-256-GCM, and ECDSA P-256
evidence.Signature Schemes: PqdsaKeyPair , PqdsaPublicKey , PqdsaPrivateKey , PqdsaSigningAlgorithm , PqdsaVerificationAlgorithm , and the ML_DSA_44 / ML_DSA_65 / ML_DSA_87 algorithms

product_brief: Software cryptographic module providing FIPS-approved algorithms for TLS-protected communication and data and key encryption in the TrustedKeep Product.
pqc_support: Yes — ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer) and ML-KEM (KeyGen, EncapDecap) listed among CAVP algorithm capabilities
pqc_capability_description: CAVP certificate A8857 lists ML-DSA KeyGen/SigGen/SigVer and ML-KEM EncapDecap/KeyGen as validated algorithm capabilities, alongside classical algorithms, on AlmaLinux 9 on AMD EPYC 9224. Software module, version 2.15.1.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-CMAC, AES-CTR, AES-GCM, ECDSA (FIPS186-5), EDDSA, RSA (FIPS186-5), ML-DSA, ML-KEM, KAS-ECC-SSC, KTS-IFC, HMAC (SHA2/SHA3), SHA2, SHA3, SHAKE/cSHAKE, Counter DRBG, HMAC DRBG, HKDF, SP800-108 KDF, SSH KDF, TLS v1.2/v1.3 KDF, PBKDF
signature_schemes: ECDSA (FIPS186-5, including deterministic SigGen), EDDSA, RSA (FIPS186-5), ML-DSA
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP algorithm validation (certificate A8857, first validated 8/13/2026)

evidence.Crypto Primitives: Software Cryptographic Module providing the FIPS approved algorithms used by the TrustedKeep Product for TLS protected communication, and data and key encryption.

product_brief: Cryptographic implementation integrated into Provision products, listed in the NIST CAVP validation program.

pqc_capability_description: The CAVP entry A9146 lists ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen) and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer) on ProHarden OS 6 on Intel Xeon Silver 4310. Validation is of algorithm implementations (CAVP); parameter sets not stated.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-ECB, AES-GCM, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA
primary_platforms: ProHarden OS 6 on Intel Xeon Silver 4310
regulatory_status: CAVP validation A9146 listed on NIST CSRC; first validated 10/8/2026
testing_&_validation_methods: NIST CAVP algorithm validation (certificate A9146) covering AES, ML-DSA, ML-KEM and SLH-DSA

evidence.PQC Capability Description: ProHarden OS 6 on Intel Xeon Silver 4310 Expand ML-KEM EncapDecap Expand
